lines: # Tool-agent rollout loop: tool-call extraction fix
The bug was in what `examples/tool_agent/agent_loop.py` handed to SGLang's tool-call detectors, and in
-three of those detectors themselves. The loop now extracts calls itself (`extract_tool_calls`), with the
+several of those detectors themselves. The loop now extracts calls itself (`extract_tool_calls`), with the
model's reasoning parser name passed from `launch/run_tool_agent.py` as `--generate-reasoning-parser`
(falling back to `--sglang-reasoning-parser`). Samples, tokens, loss masks, final text and rewards are
untouched: only which calls execute, and with what arguments, changed.
